method_limits.full_semantic_source_read: I personally read the full source flow/API contract. This is not a claim of formal verification or rederivation of all mathematics.
method_limits.bounded_semantic_or_interface_read: Only recorded source ranges or selections personally read; remaining bytes still receive complete fingerprint and structural parsing.
method_limits.mechanical_json: All 282 JSON files completely parsed, recursively traversed and candidate path+sha pairs inspected by machine. Historic review verdict/issue/author-answer values not semantically read.
method_limits.mechanical_python: All 139 Python files parsed to full AST; definitions/imports indexed. This does not mean every implementation line was semantically reread.
method_limits.tests: 25 scoped test files collected in the existing CPU venv; 908 passed, one module skip, three training cases deselected; the weight-update test file was excluded entirely. Runtime coverage is exactly the executed cases, not all code paths.
